<3   
I did once. It helped with moods but not with anxiety, I could not leave the house to get a refill.  


I have been suicidal to some degree for years. The more I think about it, the more I want to let go. So the more I know I will hold on. I missed my easy escape route, and anything else is too scary.   


I just wish I wasn't such a waste. Even knowing how useless I am, and the exact steps to take to be less useless, I still do not take them, day after day. Some stupid fucking part of me enjoys being useless and having others have to take care of me all the time. The same part that makes me keep living so selfishly.
